Autosaves

Your work is saved in this browser every few seconds while you edit. The last three sessions are kept, so you can go back if something goes wrong.

Opening one can be undone with Ctrl+Z

⚠ Reset everything?

This clears the map you're working on, all your brush painting, icons, uploaded pictures and settings, and goes back to the eden2 sample.

Your app theme, cursor and key binds stay. Ctrl+Z straight afterwards brings your work back, and it's also kept in Settings → Autosaves.

Key binds

Mouse wheel on an icon

Drop map file

Mirror copy

Copies the walls, ground and icons from one half onto the other, for fair two-team maps. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

Turned copy (180°)

The copy is turned round instead of flipped, so each team's base faces the other's — the usual layout for Savage maps.
Brush size 18px — [ ] to resize · right-drag paints the opposite
Placing
Click the map to drop it · right-click an icon to delete it
Click an icon to select it, then drag to move, scroll to resize, or press R to rotate. Right-click deletes. The title and credit can be dragged too.
Scroll to resize · Shift+scroll or R to turn · Ctrl+C/V to copy
